walls.note: Lier town wall c.1650, traced from the Ferraris map (1777): the 14th-15th-c. enceinte with moat (vesten) and a few later bastions. Local metres around the Grote Markt (x east, z south).

landmarks.y1650: Brabant-Gothic collegiate church, main bell tower of Lier.
Belfry of 1369 on the market (the cloth hall beside it was replaced by the town hall in 1740).
